title: Redirect flexdashboard, gradethis, ggcheck, tblcheck to GitHub Pages
description:
Switch four packages from Netlify proxy (200) to 301 redirects pointing at their GitHub Pages sites. Companion to the per-package PRs that updated `_pkgdown.yml` URLs and CI workflows.

## Changes to `_redirects`

| Package | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| flexdashboard | `https://flexdashboard-pkg.netlify.app/:splat 200` | `https://rstudio.github.io/flexdashboard/:splat 301` |
| gradethis | `https://gradethis.netlify.app/:splat 200` | `https://rstudio.github.io/gradethis/:splat 301` |
| ggcheck | `https://ggcheck-pkg.netlify.app/:splat 200` | `https://rstudio.github.io/ggcheck/:splat 301` |
| tblcheck | `https://tblcheck-pkg.netlify.app/:splat 200` | `https://rstudio.github.io/tblcheck/:splat 301` |

## Related PRs (all merged)

- rstudio/flexdashboard#463
- rstudio/gradethis#367
- rstudio/ggcheck#39
- rstudio/tblcheck#137

## Note

Once this merges, the Netlify sites for these four packages (`flexdashboard-pkg.netlify.app`, `gradethis.netlify.app`, `ggcheck-pkg.netlify.app`, `tblcheck-pkg.netlify.app`) can be decommissioned.

title: Add redirect following `connectapi` move to `posit-dev` org
description:
We're in the process of moving `connectapi` organizations, from `rstudio` to `posit-dev` (https://github.com/rstudio/connectapi/issues/352). It'll need a redirect for its `pkgs.rstudio.com` URL to continue to work.

I'm not in control of exactly when the move happens, so it's not possible for the changes to happen completely synchronously.

Let me know if you need any other info!

title: Remove netlify redirect for flexdashboard, use github pages
description:
Removes the redirect to the Netlify-hosted flexdashboard package site. The general `/* -> rstudio.github.io/:splat` should still work.

It also turns our previous distill-based page into a Quarto static page and adds the setup needed to make the package listing dynamic: add packages to `packages.yml` to have them included on the page. This makes the listing customizable in ordering and allows us to list packages that aren't in the `_redirects` file (which is no longer used as the source of truth).

title: Build index.html automatically
description:
This is a PR to build on GHA the index page. 

For this purpose I introduced the use of **renv** 📦 . The project has a `renv.lock` that we are using to install all the required dependencies. This also allows to cache the packages and speed up installation. 

Currently the action terminate by committing to the branch. However, I believe this is deployed using netlify, isn't it ? 

* How does that work currently ? 
* Should we use netlify cli to deploy the website (using SITE_ID secrets) ? In this case we could put all the necessary files in a `_site` folder and publish this folder ? 

Depending on this above, we need to adjust this PR. 

This PR does not touch the way it works currently to add a new site i.e adding to `_redirects`. 
We could maybe have a YAML to store the website and package name, and the Rmd rendering would write the `_redirects` file. I'll open an issue to track this.
